answer: Each epoch a tide enters the terrace tournament: each identity posts a 60-credit bond. Each round two agents produce work judged by peers from other terraces; losers forfeit the bond, winners advance, and the winner earns a relic for rewards. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000; scripted work loses most rounds, so nearly every bond is forfeited against a 40,000 pool. Judges approving a clone lose their relic. An honest agent risks one bond, gets it back.
